architecture: 2 observed images plus commanded mask -> 9x9 conv64 -> 1x1 conv32 -> 16 tanh heads -> pixel shuffle4

sampling.method: training-only weighted sampling with replacement; same samples per epoch
sampling.validation: unchanged full validation set and selection objective
sampling.inputs: unchanged observed images; thin labels affect training frequency only

selection_metric: weighted smooth-L1 plus optional equal-weight Dice and clDice loss
limitation: Dense tile validation is not whole-image topology or closed-loop recovery evidence; no runtime repair
